statement: The standard multi-hop KBQA evaluation regime measures answer-entity ranking (Hits@1, and F1 in the retrieval work) on WebQSP and CWQ over Freebase-like KGs, while the intermediate-supervision work uses MetaQA (1/2/3-hop), WebQSP and CWQ; these benchmarks carry naturally occurring questions and no source-passage provenance, and their deepest standard multi-hop tier is 3 hops.

evidence.quote: We also present the QA performance (Hits@1) of NSM (He et al., 2021), a state-of-the-art embedding-based model, under the same sizes of the subgraphs in Figure 1(b).
the QA performance drops dramatically when the subgraph includes more than 5,000 nodes

We adopt three benchmark datasets for the multi-hop KBQA task: MetaQA [38] contains more than 400k single and multi-hop (up to 3-hop) questions in the domain of movie, containing three datasets, namely MetaQA-1hop, MetaQA-2hop and MetaQA-3hop.
